title: Oceanography CTDCruiseStations

stats.done_summary: Completed CTD cruise station integration and analysis. Added reproducible pipeline (code/analyze_ctd.py) to infer columns, compute TEOS-10 properties (SA, CT, sigma0), MLD, N², generate profile/TS/section figures, and save processed outputs (outputs/ctd_processed_long.csv, outputs/ctd_profiles_summary.csv, outputs/ctd_N2.csv, outputs/ctd_summary.json). Generated publication-style report at report/report.md (also copied to report/ctd_report.md) with mandatory figures saved as PNGs in report/images/.
